name: Palette_SetPendingFlags
notes: sets bits in p->pending; paired bitwise-OR setter used throughout Palette_ApplyFrame to request deferred work

name: Palette_TestPendingFlags

name: Palette_GetColorSet
notes: returns p->colorSets[set][slot], the shared accessor used by the transition/overlay helpers

name: Palette_PickTransitionColors
notes: picks two random variant colorSets via sub_08227950 and stores them as t->from/t->to for the crossfade

name: Palette_GetBrightnessThreshold
notes: returns the target brightness (0x20 or 0x40) based on gUnk_03005430.state; shared by all the brightness-mode step functions

name: Palette_BrightnessIdle
notes: mode-0 per-frame handler: holds brightness at 0 and flushes any pending t->callback

name: Palette_BrightnessFadeIn
notes: mode-1 per-frame handler: ramps t->brightness up by 4 toward the threshold, then switches to mode 2

name: Palette_BrightnessHold
notes: mode-2 per-frame handler: tracks t->brightness toward the (possibly changing) threshold and fires t->callback

name: Palette_BrightnessFadeOut
notes: mode-3 per-frame handler: ramps t->brightness down by 2 to 0, then resets to mode 0

name: Palette_BlendTransitionColors
notes: blends t->from/t->to into p->blendBuffer at t->level and marks the controller dirty

name: Palette_BlendOverlay
notes: blends the active base palette with t->colors at t->brightness into p->effectBuffer and marks dirty

name: Palette_BuildOverlayColors
notes: scales colorSets[0][2] by a fixed 0x32 into t->colors, preparing the overlay tint used by Palette_BlendOverlay

name: Palette_AdvanceTransitionBlend
notes: calls Palette_BlendTransitionColors then increments t->level (capped at 0x40); the pending-bit-2 step handler

name: Palette_ApplyOverlayBlend
notes: thin wrapper over Palette_BlendOverlay; the pending-bit-4 handler invoked from Palette_ApplyFrame

name: Palette_ResetTransition
notes: re-picks the variant color pair, snaps t->level to max, and rebuilds/blends immediately (no animation) after init or a resource swap

name: Palette_UpdateBlendSlide
notes: advances p->slide toward its target over slide.duration using Div and writes the result to p->blend; the non-oscillating counterpart to Palette_Update

name: Palette_InitBlendSlide
notes: resets p->slide to its resting state (start/target/value = 0x40, time/duration = 0)

name: Palette_SetVariantsFromSource
notes: copies colorSets[SOURCE] pointers into colorSets[VARIANT] slot-for-slot; the non-blending counterpart used when blend is disabled

name: Palette_SetVariantsFromPalettes

name: Palette_Destroy

name: Palette_GetOrCreate

name: Palette_SetBrightnessMode

name: Palette_IsDirty

name: Palette_SetBlend

name: Palette_ReplaceResourceFromScript

name: Palette_StartSlide

name: Palette_StartSlideFromScript

name: Palette_GetTransitionLevel

name: Palette_GetBrightness

name: ColorFade_StepFadeOut

name: ColorFade_StepFadeIn

name: ColorFade_UpdateChannel

name: ColorFade_SetImmediate

name: ColorFade_PublishOutputs

name: ColorFade_SetMode

name: ColorFade_OnUpdate

name: ColorFade_OnDestroy

name: ColorFade_Init
